failed.description: Never sent because of an error

count.description: Number of emails created (matches input length)

emails.description: Per-row result. status is "queued" for normal sends, "scheduled" if scheduled_at is in the future, or "failed" if the row has no deliverable To recipient left after suppression (cc and bcc alone do not send).

pause_reason.description: Why the campaign was paused, for example the complaint rate that tripped the guard

paused_at.description: Set when the campaign was stopped mid-send by the deliverability guard

disposable.description: The address is on a known throwaway-mailbox domain (set when the contact is created).

name.description: A human-readable name for the key

scopes.description: Optional list of scopes to restrict the key. Available: email:send, email:read, domain:read, domain:write, contact:read, contact:write, form:read, form:write, webhook:read, webhook:write, apikey:manage. If omitted the key gets the default set (everything except apikey:manage). Listing, creating or revoking keys through the API requires apikey:manage.

markdown.description: Markdown body. Must include {{unsubscribe_url}} or {{{RESEND_UNSUBSCRIBE_URL}}} before sending.

segment_ids.description: Manual segment IDs to assign this contact to

turnstileSecretKey.description: Write-only. Returned forms expose turnstile_secret_configured instead.

diagnostic_code.description: Optional internal note for manual suppressions

events.description: List of event types to subscribe to. Legacy unprefixed email aliases are accepted and normalized to Resend-style email.* event names.

url.description: The URL that will receive webhook POST requests

receivingEnabled.description: Whether inbound email is turned on for the domain (list responses).

data.description: Event details: bounce type, clicked URL, error message, and similar

confirmation_email.description: The confirmation email and its current status. Null when no email was queued for this signup, or for signups recorded before this was tracked.

country.description: Two-letter country code, or T1 when the signup came through Tor. The IP address is not stored.

source_url.description: The page the form was submitted on: address plus utm_* parameters only.

approvable_total.description: How many of the matching signups Approve all would confirm.

tor_total.description: How many of the matching signups were submitted through Tor. Approve all leaves these out.

undeliverable_total.description: How many of the matching signups have an undeliverable confirmation email. Approve all leaves these out.

download_url.description: Present on the attachment endpoints; valid for 15 minutes

attachments.description: Up to 10 files, base64 encoded, 25 MB per message in total. A content_id makes the part inline: reference it from the HTML as cid:<content_id>.

content_id.description: Letters, digits, . _ - with an optional @domain; sent inline as multipart/related

inline.description: Send inline even without a content_id (a Content-ID is derived from the filename)

from.description: Sender email address (must belong to a verified domain)

html.description: HTML body of the email. Include `{{unsubscribe_url}}` (or the Resend-compatible `{{{RESEND_UNSUBSCRIBE_URL}}}`) anywhere in the body and SMTPfast substitutes the per-recipient unsubscribe link at send time. The same URL is set on the RFC 8058 `List-Unsubscribe` header automatically.

text.description: Plain text fallback body. Supports the same `{{unsubscribe_url}}` placeholder as the HTML body.

account_list.description: What happened at Amazon SES's account-level suppression list. Hard-bounce and complaint suppressions are released there too (removed, or absent when SES no longer had it); manual and unsubscribe suppressions are team-specific and skipped. failed means the local suppression is gone but SES could not be updated; a later send to the address may still bounce as OnAccountSuppressionList.

segment_ids.description: Replace this contact's manual segment assignments

turnstileSecretKey.description: Write-only. Omit to keep the existing secret.

active.description: Set to false to pause delivery without deleting the webhook

response.description: First 500 characters of the last response body
